scope: Higgsfield read-only model constraints; no generation benchmark

seedance_2_5.name: Seedance 2.5
seedance_2_5.description: Seedance 2.5 text-to-video, multimodal omni-reference generation, video edit, and video extension

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Generation mode: 't2v' for prompt-only generation, 'omni_reference' for image, video, or audio references, 'video_edit' to edit one reference video (billed by that video's duration; 'duration' and 'aspect_ratio' are ignored), or 'video_extension' to extend a reference video ('aspect_ratio' is ignored — the output follows the extended video).

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Duration in seconds (4-30). Whole number.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Output resolution.

parameters.name: generate_audio
parameters.description: Generate audio for the output video.

parameters.name: bitrate_mode
parameters.description: 'standard' = normal output bitrate; 'high' = higher bitrate output.

parameters.name: extension_mode
parameters.description: Extension direction; required for mode 'video_extension' and not allowed otherwise.

parameters.name: draft
parameters.description: Generate a 480p draft that can be finalized within seven days.

parameters.name: draft_job_id
parameters.description: Completed draft job to finalize at the selected resolution. The final renders the draft's full duration and is billed for it; 'duration' is ignored.

medias.name: medias
medias.description: Media roles: start_image — First frame of the output video (mode 'omni_reference' only). | end_image — Last frame of the output video (mode 'omni_reference' only). | image_references — Reference images for subject, style, or composition (max 30 across image_references + start_image + end_image). (array, max 30) | video_references — Reference video clips (max 10). (array, max 10) | audio_references — Reference audio clips (max 10). (array, max 10)

seedream_v5_pro.name: Seedream 5.0 Pro
seedream_v5_pro.description: Pro-tier visual reasoning, instruction-based editing, up to 2K

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Output resolution tier.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Optional output width stored with the generation. Whole number.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Optional output height stored with the generation. Whole number.

parameters.name: remove_bg
parameters.description: Remove the background from the generated image.

parameters.name: is_inpaint
parameters.description: Treat the request as an inpaint/edit of the reference image(s) instead of a fresh generation.

medias.name: medias
medias.description: Media roles: image_references — Reference images to guide the generation (style, composition, subject). At most 10. (array)

gpt_image_2_6.name: GPT Image 2.6
gpt_image_2_6.description: GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst image generation and editing, GIF and SVG output

parameters.name: quality
parameters.description: Rendering quality.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Output resolution tier.

parameters.name: background
parameters.description: Background handling. Omit to keep the model default.

parameters.name: batch_size
parameters.description: Number of outputs. Whole number.

parameters.name: output_format
parameters.description: Output file format. SVG does not accept reference images.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: WIDTHxHEIGHT or auto. GIF defaults to 288x288; dimensions must divide by 16.

parameters.name: frame_count
parameters.description: GIF only. Defaults to 9. Whole number.

parameters.name: frame_duration_ms
parameters.description: GIF only. Frame duration in milliseconds; defaults to 200. Whole number.

medias.name: medias
medias.description: Media roles: image_references — Reference images for generation or editing. Not supported for SVG. (array, max 16)
